title: pm-dispatch rules: dispatch-runbook points the round-report section at SKILL.md, and lanes/triage.md says triage never releases while triage-duties carries release rules
body:
domain:skills#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaqHXh17Qc3C7MRAQw

Filing gate: ① documentation defect with a named producer (rules text that reads against other rules text on `main`), raised by the dev and the contract reviewer of PR #32485 (#32419). ⛔ Not a claim; triage decides lane and grade.

## Item 1 — dispatch-runbook names the round-report section as SKILL.md's

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md` L53: 「后两段沿用 SKILL.md 轮次报告节」. The round-report section lives in `references/seat-lifecycle.md` 〈轮次报告与节奏〉 (SKILL.md's stage index lists it there). After PR #32485 that section also carries the definition of M (open `pm:awaiting-merge` PRs), which the triage brief reaches through this pointer; review 6812671561 says this pointer sits on that reading chain.

## Item 2 — "triage never releases" reads against the release rules

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/triage.md` L19: 「⛔ 分诊永不释放」, while `references/triage-duties.md` and `references/seat-lifecycle.md` carry release rules that triage applies. Which seat may release what, in which case, should read the same in all three.

## Reach

Any seat reading these files to decide where the round-report rules live or whether triage may release a card.

## Duplicate check

Found in PR #32485's dev report 6812530387 and delta review 6812671561; no open card names either line.
